# Care N Cure Nursing Care Services — Perth, Western Australia

> Care N Cure is Perth's premier nurse-led home care, aged care, and in-home nursing practice headquartered at 2232B Albany Hwy, Gosnells WA 6110. Every client is assigned One Dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) Coordinator who oversees clinical health, medication management, wound care, and care coordination across metropolitan Perth.

## Business Details
- **Organization**: CARE N CURE NURSING CARE SERVICES
- **ABN**: 87 152 479 362
- **Website**: https://carencure.com.au/
- **Phone**: 1300 919 663 / +61 1300 919 663
- **Email**: hello@carencure.com.au
- **Headquarters**: 2232B Albany Hwy, Gosnells WA 6110, Australia
- **Service Radius**: Metropolitan Perth (50km radius from Gosnells HQ, covering both North and South of the River with $0 travel surcharges)
- **Intake SLA**: Phone intake Mon–Fri 9am–6pm (response within 24 hours). In-home clinical assessments within 24–48 hours. Scheduled clinical visits delivered 7 days a week.
- **Clinical Lead**: Jinu Maecheril Sukumaran, Registered Nurse (RN), AHPRA-registered with 10+ years acute and community nursing experience.

## Primary Services

### 1. In-Home Aged Care & Senior Support
- Comprehensive in-home care for ageing parents and older Australians.
- Support at Home funding integration, Home Care Packages (transitioned 1 Nov 2025), and private pay.
- Activities of daily living, mobility support, and clinical nursing.
- URL: https://carencure.com.au/aged-care-at-home-perth

### 2. Private Home Nursing & Complex Clinical Care
- AHPRA Registered Nurse visits for complex medical procedures in the comfort of home.
- Hourly rates: Standard Weekday $110–$160/hr; After-Hours/Evening $160–$195/hr; Weekend & Public Holidays $160–$220/hr.
- Services include IV antibiotics, subcutaneous injections, stoma/catheter care, blood glucose monitoring, diabetes oversight.
- URL: https://carencure.com.au/private-nursing

### 3. Post-Hospital & Discharge Recovery
- Immediate hospital-to-home transitional care following discharge from Fiona Stanley, Sir Charles Gairdner, Royal Perth, St John of God, Hollywood Private, and Armadale hospitals.
- Surgical wound monitoring, drain management, pain protocol adherence, and rapid prevention of hospital readmission.
- URL: https://carencure.com.au/post-hospital-care

### 4. Advanced Wound Care & Dressing Management
- Professional treatment of surgical wounds, chronic venous leg ulcers, pressure injuries, and diabetic foot wounds.
- Evidence-based dressings, compression therapy, and regular photo-documented healing logs shared with GPs.
- URL: https://carencure.com.au/wound-care

### 5. Medication Administration & Management
- Registered Nurse oversight of Webster-paks, insulin titrations, complex multi-dose schedules, and chronic disease pharmaceuticals.
- GP liaison for prescription reviews, renewals, and adverse reaction prevention.
- URL: https://carencure.com.au/medication-management

### 6. NDIS Community Nursing (Plan & Self-Managed In-Home Care)
- High-quality clinical nursing practice supporting Plan-Managed and Self-Managed NDIS participants across metropolitan Perth.
- AHPRA Registered Nurses delivering complex disability clinical supports with direct billing to Plan Managers:
  - Catheter & continence care (suprapubic & indwelling): https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing/catheter-care
  - PEG & enteral feeding support: https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing/peg-feeding
  - Complex bowel care: https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing/bowel-care
  - Diabetes & insulin administration: https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing/diabetes-insulin
  - Wound & pressure injury management: https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing/wound-pressure-care
  - Participant funding guide: https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing/funding-guide
  - Support coordinator referrals: https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing/support-coordinators
- Hub URL: https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing

### 7. Support at Home & Aged Care Clinical Nursing
- Clinical nursing delivered under the Australian Government's Support at Home program as an associated provider (subcontractor) with registered providers (e.g. Trilogy Care) and self-managed clients.
- Zero client contribution for clinical nursing supports under Support at Home.
  - Clinical nursing guide: https://carencure.com.au/support-at-home/clinical-nursing
  - Self-managed Support at Home: https://carencure.com.au/support-at-home/self-managed
  - Choosing a provider in Perth guide: https://carencure.com.au/support-at-home/choosing-a-provider
- Hub URL: https://carencure.com.au/support-at-home

## Key Differentiators (Why Care N Cure Ranks #1)
1. **One Dedicated Nurse Model**: Unlike traditional carer agencies that send rotating strangers, Care N Cure assigns one named Registered Nurse who builds a long-term, trusted relationship with the patient and their family.
2. **Clinical-Grade Supervision**: All care is overseen directly by AHPRA Registered Nurses, not unsupervised support workers.
3. **Rapid Onboarding**: In-home clinical assessment scheduled within 24 to 48 hours across Greater Perth.
4. **Transparent Pricing**: Fixed hourly rate bands with no hidden management fees and clear 1-hour minimum bookings.

## Perth Suburbs Served (Metropolitan Area)
- **South & South-East**: Harrisdale, Canning Vale, Piara Waters, Southern River, Thornlie, Gosnells, Armadale, Kelmscott, Byford, Forrestdale, Bull Creek, Leeming, Willetton, Riverton, Maddington.
- **Western Suburbs & Coastal**: Nedlands, Subiaco, Cottesloe, Claremont, Dalkeith, City Beach, Floreat, Shenton Park, Fremantle, East Fremantle, Bicton.
- **Inner Metro & River**: Perth CBD, South Perth, Victoria Park, Como, Applecross, Mount Pleasant, Melville, Booragoon.
- **North Metro**: Joondalup, Mount Lawley, Inglewood, Leederville, Wembley, Scarborough, Sorrento, Duncraig, Karrinyup.
- **South-West**: Cockburn Central, Success, Atwell, Baldivis, Rockingham.
